headline: Central Bank of Egypt Raises Benchmark Interest Rates Amid Inflation Pressures
summary: The Central Bank of Egypt raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time in nearly three years, despite easing inflation.
why: Central bank rate decisions directly influence commercial borrowing costs, currency valuations, and fixed-income yields within an economy.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Higher benchmark rates tighten monetary policy in Egypt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The unexpected rate hike by the Central Bank of Egypt signals a tighter monetary stance, shifting local yield expectations.
